title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with context: longer drafts offer greater amortization when reliable, but can waste compute on suffixes discarded after a rejection. Unlike autoregressive drafting, where a stopping rule can decide token by token, MTP must fix the horizon before drafting, as all heads fire in the same forward pass. We therefore formulate horizon selection as an online control problem, using verification feedback to learn how far the draft can be trusted in each context, and introduce Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP): a lightweight controller that requires no retraining and leaves the exact verifier unchanged. translated_title: 自适应多词元预测：我们应该走多远？
translated_abstract: 多词元预测（MTP）可以通过一次性起草多个词元，并在单次目标模型前向传播中对其进行验证，从而加速语言模型的解码。然而，最佳的推测长度会随上下文而变化：较长的草稿在可靠时能带来更大的摊销收益，但在被拒绝后可能会在被丢弃的后缀上浪费计算资源。与自回归起草方式（可以逐词元地决定停止规则）不同，MTP 必须在起草之前就确定长度，因为所有预测头都在同一次前向传播中激活。因此，我们将长度选择形式化为一个在线控制问题，利用验证反馈来学习在每个上下文中草稿可以被信任到何种程度，并提出了自适应多词元预测（AMTP）：一个轻量级的控制器，无需重新训练，且保持精确验证器不变。为了指导长度选择，我们通过接受生存率（acceptance survival），即草稿
tldr: 该论文提出自适应多词元预测（AMTP），将多词元预测的推测长度选择形式化为在线控制问题，通过轻量级控制器利用验证反馈动态调整最佳起草长度，无需重新训练即可提升语言模型解码效率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP), which formulates speculation-horizon selection as an online control problem, using a lightweight, retraining-free controller that leverages verification feedback to dynamically choose the optimal draft length and accelerate language-model decoding.
